claims.summary: The dialogue runtime performs a longest-exact single pass over known model-control markers.
claims.disposition: Verified from the complete 1,038-line source and closed as an exact duplicate of prior complete-source evidence. Longest overlap, UTF-8 scalar traversal, and ordered remainder reconstruction are unchanged.

claims.summary: Punctuation-heavy or multiword text after a marker may make first_word_after empty or misclassify a valid relation.
claims.disposition: Source-corrected and verified existing. Punctuation and whitespace are skipped until the first nonempty word. Multiword phrases are intentionally classified by that first word against the finite relation vocabulary; a tail with no word fails closed.

claims.summary: The relation word represents should preserve an exact marker across punctuation and a newline.
claims.disposition: Verified by the existing multiple-punctuation and newline regressions. Both preserve exact bytes and record following_exact_relation.

claims.summary: Declared quote delimiters separated from an exact marker by multiple whitespace forms should preserve it with a bounded delimiter receipt.
claims.disposition: Implemented a bounded test for ASCII quotes and spaces, Japanese corner quotes across tab/newline, and U+301D/U+301E across U+2003/U+3000. Every case preserves exact bytes, records quoted count one and grouped count zero, and proves delimiter depth one.

claims.summary: The marker-cleanup remainder should reach generate_dialogue rather than remain an isolated helper result.
claims.disposition: Verified across the exact provider consumers. MLX and Ollama normalize raw output before generate_dialogue validates, returns, and persists that text; cleanup matches remain separate evidence.
